title: Corner glass shelf 3-Tier 8-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Hardware Allied Brass
description:
Add vertical storage to tight bathroom corners with this wall mount corner glass shelf, featuring three tiers and thick tempered glass for everyday strength. Designed to coordinate with the Foxtrot collection for a matching Foxtrot look alongside other designer bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Three-tier corner glass shelf helps organize bath essentials in unused corner space
- 3/8-Inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges for safety and a clean, finished look
- Solid brass hardware for durable, enduring support
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a streamlined installation
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes to complement designer bathroom hardware and statement bath accessories

Specs:
- Overall size: 8-Inch L x 8-Inch W x 15-Inch H
- Glass thickness: 0.39 in
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Assembly: Not required
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Includes: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
